decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): The release note [ev-d308231cd8ab] doesn't name the new field, but the linked PR description [ev-91450e091f27] does. Its Certificate YAML example marks `spec.keystores.pkcs12.password` and `spec.keystores.jks.password` as "the new field" and "the other new field". The PR's changed files [ev-f03e1aa4c04a] include the Certificate CRD, the v1 API types and validation, which fits an added API field on cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate. Together these give the subject (two new literal `password` fields under the JKS and PKCS12 keystores), the change (added, and validation makes it mutually exclusive with `passwordSecretRef`), and an opt-in feature with no stated effect on existing Certificates [ev-8df6f0ea9b18].
